Community Concerns, Inc. · Atlanta, GA

Every family deserves a door of their own.

Tonight, hundreds of families across Atlanta are one crisis away from losing their home — and we're standing beside them so they don't face it alone.

Donate Now Join Our Mission
The Problem

Homelessness rarely starts with a single event. It starts with a gap no one catches in time.

On any given night, thousands of people across Metro Atlanta have nowhere stable to sleep — and far more are just one missed paycheck, medical bill, or rent increase away from losing their home entirely. Without fast, coordinated support, a temporary setback can turn into a permanent crisis.

1 in 3

families we serve arrive after a single unexpected expense — not years of hardship, but one gap that had nowhere else to land.

What We Do

Support that meets people exactly where they are

Every program is built around one goal: helping a family move from crisis to a stable home they can call their own.

01

Path to Permanent Housing

Hands-on support finding and securing a lease, including move-in assistance and ongoing housing stability coaching.

02

Employment & Income Support

Job readiness coaching, transportation assistance, and connections to living-wage employment opportunities.

03

Family Case Management

One dedicated caseworker per family, coordinating every resource needed — from childcare to healthcare referrals.

Impact Stories

Real families. Real turning points.

D

Denise

After losing her job during a medical emergency, Denise spent three months in emergency housing while our team helped her secure disability benefits. She moved into her own apartment last spring.

M

Marcus

A veteran facing homelessness after returning to civilian life, Marcus enrolled in our employment program and secured a full-time position within eight weeks. He now mentors other program graduates.

A

The Alvarez Family

Facing eviction with two young children, the Alvarez family worked with a caseworker to catch up on rent and build a savings plan. They've maintained stable housing for over a year.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions, answered

How is my donation used?+

Your gift goes directly toward emergency housing, permanent housing placement, employment support, and family case management. Our full annual report breaks down program spending in detail.

What does someone need to qualify for housing support?+

Eligibility varies by program. In general, we work with individuals and families currently experiencing homelessness in the Atlanta area. Contact us directly and a caseworker will walk you through what's needed.

What's required to volunteer?+

Most roles require a short orientation and, for anyone working directly with families, a background check. No special experience is required — just reliability and compassion.

Is my donation tax-deductible?+

Yes. Community Concerns Inc. is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, and gifts are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law. You'll receive a receipt for your records after donating.

Can I designate my gift to a specific program?+

Yes. You can note a specific program in your donation, or reach out directly to discuss designated or in-honor giving.

How can my company get involved as a sponsor?+

We partner with local businesses through event sponsorship, in-kind donations, and employee volunteer days. Contact us using the information below to talk through options.
